Record Class Card

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.brandeis.cosi.atg.cards.Card
Record Components:
type - the type of the card
id - the unique identifier for this card
public record Card(Card.Type type, int id) extends Record
Represents a card in the game.

Cards have types that determine their category, value, and cost. They also have ids, which are unique to each card in the game. The id of a card is used to distinguish it from other cards of the same type. Two cards are considered equal if they have the same type and id.

The three broad categories of cards are: ACTION, MONEY, and VICTORY.
